derivation: Hand-derived, never run, from the ssgi-cpu contract. update_sectors: start = min(floor(min_u x 32), 31), count = min(ceil((max_u - min_u) x 32), 32 - start), mask = (2^count - 1) << start, and 0 when count is 0. sector_u: (sin(clamp(theta - gamma, -PI/2, PI/2)) + 1) / 2 with PI/2 = 1.5707963, PI/6 = 0.5235988 and PI = 3.1415927. sample_bits: back = delta - view x thickness; each face gives side x acos(dot(normalize(p), view)) and a sector coordinate, and the mask spans both. accumulate: new = bits & ~mask, irradiance += radiance x popcount(new) / 32, and it returns mask | bits. resolve: E = PI x mean(sum), V = mean(1 - popcount(mask) / 32), and ([0, 0, 0], 1) for no slices. compose: (E + V x probe.rgb, min(V, probe.a)). temporal_alpha: 0.1 whatever the motion. Masks compare exactly; floats within 1e-5.

update_sectors.derivation: start = floor(0) = 0; count = ceil(0.25 x 32) = 8; mask = (2^8 - 1) << 0 = 255.
count = ceil((0.3 - 0.3) x 32) = ceil(0) = 0, so the mask is 0.
start = 0; count = ceil(1.0 x 32) = 32; mask = 2^32 - 1 = 4294967295, every sector.
start = min(floor(32), 31) = 31; count = ceil(0) = 0, so the mask is 0.

sector_u.derivation: theta - gamma = PI/2, on the clamp bound; (sin(PI/2) + 1) / 2 = (1 + 1) / 2 = 1.
theta - gamma = -PI/2, on the clamp bound; (sin(-PI/2) + 1) / 2 = (-1 + 1) / 2 = 0.
theta - gamma = PI is clamped to PI/2; (sin(PI/2) + 1) / 2 = 1.

accumulate.derivation: bits 16776960 = 0xFFFF00 and mask 65535 = 0xFFFF: new = bits & ~mask = 0xFF0000, popcount 8, so irradiance += (1,0,0) x 8 / 32 = (0.25,0,0); mask | bits = 0xFFFFFF = 16777215.
The same new sectors open, but facing is false, so nothing is added; mask | bits = 16777215.

resolve.derivation: One slice: sum (1,1,1) and mask 4294967295 has popcount 32, so V = 1 - 32/32 = 0; E = PI x (1,1,1) / 1 = 3.141593 in each channel: a fully covered uniform radiance L gives PI L.
Slice 1 has mask 0, open 1 - 0/32 = 1; slice 2 has mask 0xFFFF0000 with popcount 16, open 1 - 16/32 = 0.5; V = (1 + 0.5) / 2 = 0.75. Sum (0.5,0,0), mean (0.25,0,0), E = PI x 0.25 = 0.785398.
No slices: nothing is occluded, so ([0,0,0], 1).

compose.derivation: Open surface: E = 0 and V = 1, so rgb = probe.rgb exactly and alpha = min(1, 0.9) = 0.9: the probe passes through unchanged.

temporal_alpha.derivation: A pixel that moved 5 px keeps the same weight: 0.1.
A pixel that moved 20 px keeps the same weight: 0.1.
